rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Saturday, US markets closed — spot crypto only. Crypto is consolidating after the Oct 7 selloff (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP -4% to -6% on rising oil, hawkish Fed minutes, ~$487M long liquidations). BTC flat (+0.3% vs midnight ET); spot BTC ETFs still took a small $21M inflow Oct 9 while ETH (-$56M) and SOL (5th straight day) ETFs bled.
positions.driver: No fresh weekend catalyst = low-edge day, so park in the lowest-vol, best-bid major. BTC has relative strength (ETF inflows) vs ETH/SOL (outflows), and Friday's tech rebound + LITE 'sold out to 2029' comment supports risk sentiment into the weekend. Beat ETH-USD (ETF outflows), SOL-USD (5-day ETF outflows, higher beta to downside), XRP-USD (flat flows, no catalyst).
positions.risks: Weekend Iran/oil headline, hawkish Fed repricing (10Y ~5.3%), thin weekend liquidity / liquidation cascade. Hard stop 74454.89 (-10%).
